scope: Two V100 independent native instances; same pinned Q5 artifact, A16 with FP16 decoded weights, no MTP/prefix reuse; frozen serial conv/GDN chunked-dense control vs safe-auto chunked-dense with qualified batched conv/GDN. Fused Q5 remains unqualified and is excluded; this is not a fusion speedup or a comparison against broken historical code.

artifact.source_precision: Pinned existing Q5 canonical artifact; original upstream repository/revision unavailable; not a BF16/corpus quality claim

gpu_contamination_policy: Read-only NVML every 50ms; retain/discard contaminated complete cohorts; bounded new timing attempts, never retry failed generation. No observed foreign contexts is not proof of exclusivity between samples.
hardware_counters: not measured; no permissions/monitor changes; outside supervisor samples GPU busy/VRAM/power/clocks/temperature
